watches.name: DEVI - A Tribute to Divine Strength
watches.description: Where Sacred Tradition Meets Precision Timekeeping A symbolic timepiece inspired by strength, balance, and quiet resilience. DEVI is more than a watch — it is an embodiment of power, grace, and protective energy. Inspired by the iconography of Maa Durga, this timepiece serves as a modern talisman for the bold, the compassionate, and the resolute. The Artistry of the Dial At the heart of DEVI lies a meticulously crafted dial featuring the symbolic visage of Maa Durga, rendered with depth and intention. The Golden Nath (nose ring) is thoughtfully integrated as an applied index, creating dimensionality and bringing the Devi to life. It is not merely decorative — it anchors the dial in cultural authenticity. The Trishul Seconds Hand moves with deliberate precision. Time does not drift — it advances with purpose. The trident symbolizes balance and the destruction of negativity, sweeping across the dial in measured rhythm. Leaf-shaped hour and minute hands provide a soft, organic counterpoint to the powerful iconography — refined, legible, and elegant. Built for the Modern World While its soul is spiritual, its construction is uncompromisingly mechanical. The 39mm case is crafted from premium 316L stainless steel, featuring a coin-edged bezel, polished lugs, and vertically brushed case sides. At 11.4mm including sapphire crystal, it maintains a balanced wrist presence. Lug width is 20mm with a 47mm lug-to-lug span. A 6mm onion-style screw-down crown with embossed logo enhances grip and reinforces water resistance. Powered by the Miyota 82S0 automatic movement from Japan, the Trishul sweeps smoothly — a reminder that tradition and engineering can coexist in harmony. Protected by a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal and rated to 5 ATM water resistance, DEVI is designed for everyday resilience. The strap is crafted from vegan hemp fabric and fitted with quick-release spring bars, ensuring versatility and ease of wear.

watches.name: Sholavaram III Type 49
watches.description: Where Mechanical Engineering Takes Flight A chronograph inspired by India’s early aviation pioneers and the legendary Sholavaram airfield. The Sholavaram III Type 49 is a tribute to an era when precision instruments guided pilots through uncertainty. It reflects a time when engineering was visible, mechanical, and unapologetically functional. This is not a decorative chronograph — it is built around a true mechanical column-wheel movement. The Dial Architecture The dial layout echoes vintage cockpit instrumentation. Subdials are positioned for immediate legibility, allowing elapsed time to be read without hesitation. Applied hour markers and contrasting hands ensure clarity under varying light conditions. The proportions are deliberate — nothing is ornamental without purpose. The pushers deliver firm, mechanical feedback, reinforcing the tactile experience of operating a true chronograph. Mechanical Depth Inside beats the Seagull ST1901 hand-wound chronograph movement — a column-wheel calibre with visible mechanical complexity. Turn the watch over and the exhibition caseback reveals bridges, gears, and levers in motion — a reminder that this is engineering, not electronics. The 40mm 316L stainless steel case combines brushed and polished surfaces for structural durability and refined finishing. At 13.5mm thickness with a 47mm lug-to-lug span, it maintains presence without overwhelming the wrist. A sapphire crystal protects the dial, and 50m water resistance ensures everyday resilience. Paired with a leather strap and stainless steel tang buckle, the Type 49 bridges historical inspiration and modern reliability.

When the idea of Sortie was conceived nearly five years ago, it would have been easy to attach it to a legendary aircraft — Rafale, Sukhoi, MIG-21, Mirage, Harrier, De Havilland. To the airman whose discipline, judgment, and courage determine the outcome — long before the machine does. Designed Around Transition The Sortie represents transition. It is an analog mechanical watch — yet its indices are designed in the form of seven-segment LED displays. A deliberate reference to the shift from analog cockpit instrumentation to digital systems. It bridges eras. The high double-curved sapphire crystal rises above the dial, reminiscent of a fighter jet canopy — aerodynamic, protective, and purposeful. The grey fumé dial transitions from lighter tones at the center to darker edges, creating depth without compromising clarity. Modern Execution The case is available in brushed and polished stainless steel or black PVD, allowing each collector to choose a distinct personality. Every finish enhances the character of the watch without overshadowing its core philosophy. Sortie is not about spectacle — it is about intent. As with all Ajwain timepieces, refinement is ongoing.
